prompt: A close-up view of a bustling cyberpunk street food stall at night, slick with rain and lit by neon. The stall counter is cluttered with a steaming bowl of noodles and a pair of chrome chopsticks. A robotic serving arm is handing a customer a glowing beverage in a futuristic cup. A holographic menu floats above the stall, displaying animated dishes. On the counter, a data chip sits next to a portable payment terminal. A small, humming generator powers a neon sign shaped like a dragon. Several stacked food crates are visible behind the counter, alongside a large canister of cooking gas. A discarded energy cell lies on the wet ground. This is a high-tech future, so there is no old-fashioned paper money or a vintage wooden cash register. The food is synthetic and prepared quickly, so you won't find a whole raw fish or a large bag of potatoes. Despite the rain, no one is using a simple cloth umbrella.
